get.summary: Get authenticated user's recent activity feed
get.description:
Return a combined activity feed of recent pull requests and issues authored
by the authenticated user.

Each event has: ``id``, ``type``, ``title``, ``repo`` (owner/name),
``author`` (username), ``created_at`` (ISO-8601).

Return a public profile for the given username including repo count.

``follower_count`` and ``following_count`` are stubbed at 0 until the
social-graph feature is implemented.

get.description:
Return branches from the DB cache.  This is fast and suitable for
rendering a branch selector dropdown.

The git_engine (Module 8) keeps this cache in sync on every push.
Use the ``/git/branches`` endpoint (below) if you need live data
directly from pygit2.
Return branches directly from pygit2 (bypasses DB cache).

get.summary: List root directory tree at ref
List directory tree at ref + path

get.description:
Return the content of a file at *path* and *ref*.

Content is base64-encoded in the ``content`` field.  The ``mime_type``
field gives a best-effort MIME type (e.g. ``text/plain``,
``image/png``).  Clients should decode the content before display.

Locate and return the README at *ref* as raw Markdown (UTF-8).

Searches for ``README.md``, ``readme.md``, ``README.rst``, ``README``
in that order.  Returns 404 if no README-like file is found.

post.summary: Upload files and create a commit
post.description:
Accept one or more files via multipart upload and commit them to *branch*
using pygit2.

- The files are placed under *target_path* inside the repository tree.
- If *branch* does not exist, it is created from HEAD (or as an orphan
  if the repository is empty).
- Returns the new commit SHA.

Fork the repository into the authenticated user's namespace
(or an org they admin, via ``owner_organization_id`` query param).

BlobOut.title: BlobOut
BlobOut.description:
Raw file content.

Content is base64-encoded so the JSON envelope is always valid UTF-8
even for binary files (images, compiled artifacts, etc.).  The client
decodes using the ``encoding`` field.

BranchInfo.title: BranchInfo
BranchInfo.description: A single branch entry in the branch list.

CommitInfo.title: CommitInfo
CommitInfo.description: One entry in the commit log.

FileUploadResult.title: FileUploadResult
FileUploadResult.description: Returned after a successful web upload commit.

IssueOut.title: IssueOut
IssueOut.description: Full issue representation — returned by create, get, and update.

PersonalAccessTokenCreateResponse.title: PersonalAccessTokenCreateResponse
PersonalAccessTokenCreateResponse.description:
Returned ONLY at creation time -- the raw token is never retrievable
again afterward (only its hash is stored), matching standard PAT UX
(GitHub, GitLab, etc.).

PersonalAccessTokenOut.title: PersonalAccessTokenOut
PersonalAccessTokenOut.description:
Used for listing existing tokens -- deliberately excludes the raw
token and even the hash, since neither should ever be exposed after creation.

ReadmeOut.title: ReadmeOut
ReadmeOut.description:
README file content returned as raw Markdown.

The frontend is responsible for rendering and sanitising the Markdown —
this keeps XSS concerns entirely on the client and avoids a hard
dependency on a server-side renderer.

name.title: Name
name.description: Repository name.  Only letters, digits, hyphens, underscores, and dots are allowed.

RepositoryOut.title: RepositoryOut
RepositoryOut.description: Full repository representation returned by most repo endpoints.

StartupOut.title: StartupOut
StartupOut.description:
Startup representation returned by list and detail endpoints.

``member_count`` and ``open_roles_count`` are computed at query time
so the frontend can display them without an extra round-trip.

TreeEntryOut.title: TreeEntryOut
TreeEntryOut.description:
One entry in a directory listing.

``type`` is ``"blob"`` for files and ``"tree"`` for sub-directories,
mirroring the git object model and the GitHub REST API shape.

TreeOut.title: TreeOut
TreeOut.description: Directory listing at a ref + path.

TwoFactorChallengeResponse.title: TwoFactorChallengeResponse
TwoFactorChallengeResponse.description: Returned instead of TokenPair when 2FA is required.

TwoFactorLoginRequest.title: TwoFactorLoginRequest
TwoFactorLoginRequest.description:
Second step of login when the account has 2FA enabled. `challenge_token`
is a short-lived, purpose-scoped token issued by the first login step --
it proves password verification already succeeded, without yet granting
full API access.

UserBrief.title: UserBrief
UserBrief.description: Minimal user representation embedded in issue responses.

UserOut.title: UserOut
UserOut.description: Public-safe user representation, returned by the API.

UserProfileUpdate.title: UserProfileUpdate
UserProfileUpdate.description: All fields optional -- PATCH semantics, only provided fields are changed.
